issues.description: Interface naming/type mismatch for the rideable capability: the problem statement and template refer to a Rideable interface (with method messageOnRide()), but the solution repository defines and uses an interface named Mountable for that purpose while Rideable.java in the solution is empty. This inconsistency means students reading the solution or comparing to the template will see different interface names and will be unsure which interface to implement/use. It also breaks correspondence with the template's Main which expects Rideable, and may cause tests or student code that references Rideable to fail when compared with the solution.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the solution repository consistent with the problem statement and template by using the same interface name. Either (A) rename Mountable.java to Rideable.java (or have Mountable extend/alias Rideable) and have Pig and Seal implement Rideable, and fill Rideable.java with the messageOnRide() signature; or (B) update the template/problem to refer to Mountable instead of Rideable (less desirable). Ensure Rideable.java in the solution is a proper interface with String messageOnRide() so template Main and tests align with the solution.

issues.description: The problem statement and the template reference an interface named `Rideable` (UML and commented starter code), but the solution implementation introduces and uses an interface named `Mountable` for the same concept (providing messageOnRide()). This mismatch (Rideable vs Mountable) breaks a direct mapping between the exercise specification/template and the reference solution: students expecting to implement or use `Rideable` will find `Mountable` in the solution (and an effectively empty Rideable.java file present), which creates confusion about the intended interface name and which file to edit/implement.
issues.suggested_fix:
Align the interface name across artifacts. Prefer keeping the name from the problem/template (`Rideable`) to avoid confusing students. Practical fixes:
- Rename Mountable.java to Rideable.java (and ensure its package and filename match) and update its interface declaration to `public interface Rideable { String messageOnRide(); }`.
- Update all implementations (Pig.java, Seal.java) to `implements Rideable` instead of `Mountable`.
- Remove or populate the presently empty Rideable.java in the solution repository so there is a single, correct Rideable interface. Alternatively, if you prefer `Mountable`, update the problem statement and template to use `Mountable` consistently — but do not leave mixed names across artifacts.
